independenceRule: Layers sharing a sensor, logic solver or final element form a dependent group. Default (CCPS strict): credit only the best layer in the group. Optional beta-factor mode: group PFD = (1 - beta) x product + beta x min.
lessons: Case A reproduces your submitted result: 1.22 × 10⁻⁸ per year.
